egress: Box egress is a US IP. Lucid's product picker carries one global price table (LucidPricingConfig, no region switch); no US-only code is used or stored.
result: The old note 'no DLL in evaluation or funded' was wrong: the LucidFlex DLL is optional, chosen at checkout, and applies to evaluation and funded when on. The DLL is a dollar amount ($600 / $1,200 / $1,800 / $2,700), so dailyLossPct stays null. The stored $146 for $50K is the DLL OFF price ($136 product + $10 no-dll add-on); DLL ON is the $136 product price. Prices unchanged.

quotes: Customize at checkout: Daily Loss Limit On or Off, and 40% or 50% consistency (see LucidFlex Customization)
Pass in as few as 3 days with 40% consistency, or 2 days with the 50% consistency add-on
LucidFlex gives traders the ability to customize their account at the time of purchase.
Daily Loss Limit: On or Off
The DLL is a soft breach, so if you hit it you will simply be locked out until the next trading session.
Daily Loss Limit On: A Daily Loss Limit is enforced on both evaluation and funded accounts. Results in a lower evaluation purchase price. Your funded account gets On Demand Payouts
Daily Loss Limit Off: No Daily Loss Limit is applied during either the evaluation or funded phase. Results in a higher evaluation purchase price. Payouts follow the regular end-of-day schedule
Option 1: Daily Loss Limit ON + 40% Consistency ... Cheapest version of LucidFlex
Option 4: Daily Loss Limit OFF + 50% Consistency ... Highest pricing version of LucidFlex
Once selected, these settings cannot be changed for an active account.

priceSetupAnswer.caveat: The page never shows a DLL-ON price without the coupon. $136 is the product price in the picker's price table; with the limited-time $5 promo, the page's 'Savings total $15' off $146 implies $131 before coupon at $50K. Checkout was not reached (sign-up wall), so neither figure is checkout-verified.
